description: PostgreSQL 18 planar geometric GiST, SP-GiST, BRIN, operator-class, predicate, KNN, and mutation parity
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_geometric_indexes (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, location point, region box, boundary polygon, radius circle, unsupported_line line);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_point_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (location);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_point_kd ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING spgist (location kd_point_ops);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_box_spgist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING spgist (region);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_box_brin ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING brin (region);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_polygon_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (boundary);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_circle_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (radius);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_multi_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (location, region);
DROP INDEX type_matrix_geometric_multi_gist;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE location << point(3,0) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE point(3,0) >> location ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE region && '(1,1),(4,4)'::box ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE boundary @> '((1,1),(1.5,1),(1.5,1.5))'::polygon ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE radius && '<(1,0),1>'::circle ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes ORDER BY location <-> point(0,0) LIMIT 2;
UPDATE type_matrix_geometric_indexes SET location = point(1,1) WHERE id = 3;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE location << point(3,0) ORDER BY id;
INSERT INTO type_matrix_geometric_indexes (id, location) VALUES (4, NULL);
UPDATE type_matrix_geometric_indexes SET location = point(1,1) WHERE id = 4;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE location << point(3,0) ORDER BY id;
UPDATE type_matrix_geometric_indexes SET location = NULL WHERE id = 4;
DELETE FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE id = 2;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE location << point(3,0) ORDER BY id;
DROP INDEX type_matrix_geometric_box_spgist;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_indexes WHERE region @> point(1,1) ORDER BY id;
SELECT count(*) AS opclass_count FROM pg_opclass WHERE opcmethod IN (783, 3580, 4000) AND opcintype IN (600, 603, 604, 718);
SELECT indexname::text FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'type_matrix_geometric_indexes' AND indexname LIKE 'type_matrix_geometric_%' ORDER BY indexname;
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_invalid_point_btree ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes (location);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_invalid_line_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (unsupported_line);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_invalid_circle_spgist ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING spgist (radius);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_invalid_box_opclass ON type_matrix_geometric_indexes USING gist (region point_ops);
